observations.behavior: Replaces a simple hourly floor with a bounded, jittered, identity-aware floor and adds a 30-day cap; also adds a hand-rolled FNV-1a hash for stable per-identity rollover offsets.
observations.posthog_connection: Bounds the write frequency of event-definition updates to Postgres while avoiding synchronized rollover across pods; the jitter and identity-dependent hash spread the write load, and the 30-day cap prevents overflow or range errors.
